text: hey so IDK what or how or why but for some reason the compile game button is broken in hmsc-int :V
resolution: Compile button in hmsc-int was broken: it shells out to 'rjit game bake', which runs bakeGameFile.ts in a fresh v8cli process. That process never called ensureCookedRegistry(), so Studio-cooked props (req_1134) were missing from COOKED_CATALOG. A map with a placed cooked mesh ('prop.new_mesh_017') threw 'build catalog: unknown piece id' mid-bake, failing every Compile. Fix: bakeGameFile.ts now calls ensureCookedRegistry() before resolving placements (mirrors the editor boot in index.tsx), against the same EDITOR_DATA_ROOT store, idempotent + headless-tolerant. Verified: 'rjit game bake' now reports bake PASS and writes hmsc.gamefile.
